section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1969
title: 20 The highest volume of suicides per one lakh of population was noticed in Kerala (15.40) followed by West Bengal (12.82), Tamil Nadu (12.78) as against an All India average of (8.13). Jammu and Kashmir recorded only 14 cases. Among the Cities, Bangalore recorded the highest number (695) of suicidal deaths. Table 10 presents the relevant Statistics. TABLE 10
